name: Clinked
description_en: Clinked provides branded client workspaces that combine files, requests, conversations and tasks. A group is the working boundary; member roles and individual content permissions determine participation. Occasional Guest Share recipients are different from people with portal accounts. Document versioning, locking and approval support review work, while the separate VDR offer adds deal-room controls. A logo or custom domain does not establish isolation, backup completeness or regulatory compliance.
description_zh: Clinked 提供结合文件、请求、交流与任务的品牌化客户工作区。组构成工作边界，成员角色与具体内容权限决定参与范围。偶尔接收 Guest Share 的访客不同于拥有门户账户的人。文档版本、锁定及审批支持审阅工作，单独的 VDR 方案增加交易资料室控制。Logo 或自定义域名本身不确立隔离、备份完整性或合规。

sections.title_en: Model the client boundary before adding branding
sections.title_zh: 先确定客户边界，再配置品牌
sections.en:
Clinked brings files, task progress, discussions and communication into client-facing workspaces. It offers portal branding and integrations, but the practical unit to evaluate is the group and its content access, rather than the appearance of a shared homepage. The VDR and custom-portal offers should be scoped separately from ordinary client collaboration.

For an editorial pilot, create two synthetic client engagements with distinct deliverables and a shared internal reviewer. Define what each client may read, submit or approve. Check search, notifications, links and group navigation as each role before using real records. A branded URL is not evidence that the second client cannot discover a document, and a task marked complete is not evidence that its file was approved or signed. No group or customer record was created here.
sections.zh:
Clinked 将文件、任务进度、讨论和交流集中到面向客户的工作区，提供门户品牌及集成。但实际应评估的是组及其内容访问，而不是共享首页外观。VDR 与定制门户方案需与普通客户协作分别界定。

编辑建议的试点可建立两个虚构客户项目，设置不同交付物及一位共同内部审阅者，定义各客户可阅读、提交或批准什么。使用真实记录前，以各角色检查检索、通知、链接与组导航。品牌化 URL 不证明第二位客户无法发现文档；任务完成也不证明附件已批准或签署。本研究未创建组或客户记录。

sections.title_en: Standard members can do more than upload
sections.title_zh: Standard 成员不只是上传者
sections.en:
The help article distinguishes Group Administrators, Standard Members and Basic Members. A Standard Member cannot open group settings but can set file permissions, share with guests, upload new versions and manage group trash, including restoration and permanent deletion. Some actions extend to other groups where that person has contributor rights.

For the proposed engagements, assigning a client Standard access therefore needs a deliberate capability review. Test the intended role together with the file/folder permissions; do not infer that a non-administrator cannot broaden a share or remove content. Compare a restricted reader with a contributor using synthetic files, and inspect what changes when the user leaves the group. The documentation establishes capabilities, not proof that every package or custom role has an identical configuration. No permissions or deletion operations were performed.
sections.zh:
帮助文档区分组管理员、Standard 成员及 Basic 成员。Standard 成员不能进入组设置，但可以设置文件权限、与访客共享、上传新版本及管理组回收站，包括恢复和永久删除。部分操作还可涉及该成员有贡献者权限的其他组。

因此，在建议的客户项目中授予 Standard 访问，需有意识地审查能力。应结合目标角色及文件／文件夹权限测试，不能推断非管理员就无法扩大共享或移除内容。可用虚构文件比较受限读者与贡献者，并检查离组后结果。文档确立能力描述，不证明所有套餐或自定义角色配置完全相同。本研究未执行权限或删除操作。

sections.title_en: A folder guest share includes the tree below it
sections.title_zh: 文件夹访客共享包含下级目录树
sections.en:
A Guest Share recipient does not have a portal login. The sharing dialog can set a password, expiry, notifications and download permission. Sharing a folder includes its underlying folders and files; a separate option enables guest uploads. Permissions can later be edited or the recipient removed. The documented audit view registers a seen event when the guest clicks View, rather than merely receiving the email.

For an occasional reviewer, select a dedicated review folder and check its descendants before sharing. Prefer that explicit scope to a broad engagement root. Evaluate expired, revoked and wrong-password access and whether downloads are needed. The audit event is not proof that the recipient understood or approved the contents, and revoking a link cannot be assumed to retrieve a copy already downloaded. This research did not send an invitation or share link.
sections.zh:
Guest Share 接收者没有门户登录账户。共享对话框可设置密码、到期时间、通知及下载权限。共享文件夹会包含其下文件夹及文件；另有选项允许访客上传。之后可修改权限或移除接收者。文档所述已查看审计事件需要访客点击 View，并非收到邮件即记为已读。

偶尔参与的审阅者宜使用专门审查文件夹，共享前检查下级内容，避免直接共享整个项目根目录。应评估到期、撤销及错误密码访问，并判断是否需要下载。审计事件不证明对方理解或批准内容；撤销链接也不能假定能收回已经下载的副本。本研究未发送邀请或共享链接。

sections.title_en: Version, lock and approval answer different questions
sections.title_zh: 版本、锁定与审批回答不同问题
sections.en:
Version control advertises viewing, comparing and restoring prior file versions, with notes and upload history. File locking is intended to prevent simultaneous edits and accidental overwrite, with editor notifications. Approval records a requested review, status and decisions. These capabilities are complementary: a locked file is not necessarily approved, and an approved old revision does not prove a newly uploaded file has been reviewed.

For the proposed deliverable, upload a revision with a clearly different identifier, request review and inspect which version the decision references. Evaluate a second editor while a lock exists, and then an interrupted editing session. Confirm who can release the lock and whether a replacement invalidates earlier approval. Exact lock expiry, override and approval reset rules were not established from the public pages. Restore a synthetic prior version only after checking its effect on links and review status. None of these operations was executed.
sections.zh:
版本控制宣传可查看、比较及恢复旧文件版本，并记录备注及上传历史。文件锁定用于阻止同时编辑及意外覆盖，并通知编辑者；审批记录审查请求、状态与决定。三者相互补充：被锁文件未必已批准，旧修订已批准也不证明新上传文件经过审查。

建议交付物测试可上传标识明显不同的修订，发起审查，并检查决定对应哪个版本。再评估锁定期间第二位编辑者以及编辑中断的情形，明确谁可解除锁定、替换文件是否使既有批准失效。公开页面未确立精确锁定到期、覆盖及审批重置规则。恢复虚构旧版前，还需核对链接与审查状态的变化。本研究未执行上述操作。

sections.title_en: An emailed ZIP is an export artifact to inspect
sections.title_zh: 邮件链接中的 ZIP 需要检查
sections.en:
Account or group administrators can export group data as a ZIP and receive a download link by email when it is ready. Group settings also allow tools and notification behavior to change; hiding comment contents in notification emails can reduce what leaves the portal in an alert. A removed group can be restored or permanently deleted through trash according to the help page.

For the pilot, inspect an export for the exact engagement’s files, versions, comments, permissions and approval evidence before relying on it for handover. The article does not establish that all those objects are included or that the archive can recreate a working tenant. Check recipients and expiry of the export link and record unresolved omissions. Public evidence did not establish a universal trash-retention period or backup recovery target. No ZIP was requested, downloaded or restored.
sections.zh:
账户或组管理员可把组数据导出为 ZIP，准备完成后收到邮件下载链接。组设置还能调整工具及通知行为；在通知邮件中隐藏评论正文，可以减少提醒中离开门户的内容。帮助页也说明移除的组可通过回收站恢复或永久删除。

建议试点在把导出用于交接前，检查目标项目的文件、版本、评论、权限及审批证据。文章没有确立这些对象全部包含在内，也未确立归档可重建可工作的租户。还应检查导出链接接收者和到期设置，记录缺失项。公开证据未确立统一回收站保留期或备份恢复目标。本研究未申请、下载或恢复 ZIP。

sections.title_en: Compare the cycle and the member allowance together
sections.title_zh: 结合周期与成员额度比较价格
sections.en:
The live USD selector showed monthly prices of $11 per Start Up user, $299 for Standard and $599 for Premium. Selecting Yearly changed the displayed monthly equivalents to $8.80, $239 and $479. Standard includes 100 members and 1 TB; Premium includes 250 and 3 TB. Start Up displayed 2 GB and a 1–25 user selector, with Standard features except a custom URL.

Do not compare a per-user entry with a whole-package amount without defining who needs a portal login and who only receives a guest share. Premium lists enforced 2FA and role-based permissions; Enterprise adds SSO and SLA options. VDR pricing is custom. The reader also exposed conflicting static values; use an actual selected offer at purchase. Taxes, overages, billing totals and two-year charges were not verified, and no subscription was purchased.
sections.zh:
实际 USD 选择器显示月付价格为 Start Up 每用户 11 美元、Standard 每月 299 美元、Premium 每月 599 美元。选择 Yearly 后，显示的每月折算值分别为 8.80、239 和 479 美元。Standard 包含 100 名成员及 1 TB，Premium 为 250 名及 3 TB；Start Up 显示 2 GB、1 至 25 用户选择器，并含自定义 URL 以外的 Standard 功能。

比较按用户入口与整包价格前，应明确谁需门户登录、谁只接收访客共享。Premium 列出强制 2FA 及基于角色的权限，Enterprise 增加 SSO 和 SLA 选项；VDR 另询价。网页读取器还暴露不同静态数值，购买时应按实际选定方案。税、超额费用、账单总额及两年费用未核实，本研究未订阅。

sections.title_en: Confirm trial, renewal and deletion in the applicable agreement
sections.title_zh: 在适用协议中确认试用、续期与删除
sections.en:
Clinked is Rabbitsoft’s proprietary service, not an open-source license. General charges are non-refundable, while the terms describe specific upgrade transitions with unused-quota credits. They also contain automatic-renewal and 30-day notice language. Current marketing describes a 14-day trial, but the January 2026 terms still mention 10 days and free accounts. These differences need confirmation for the actual order; neither a permanent free tier nor a uniform cancellation right is established here.

The privacy notice says deactivation removes account access and visibility while backup copies may remain for legal/compliance reasons. Retention is purpose-based, without a fixed purge deadline. Separate ending a subscription, deactivating an account, removing a guest and requesting deletion. Obtain the data exit artifact before losing access and verify the selected hosting/processor terms. This research did not cancel, accept an agreement or request erasure.
sections.zh:
Clinked 是 Rabbitsoft 的专有服务，不是开源许可。一般费用不退款，但条款另述特定升级转换中的未使用额度折抵，并包含自动续期与 30 天通知措辞。当前宣传描述 14 天试用，2026 年 1 月条款仍提到 10 天及免费账户，实际订单需确认这些差异。本研究未据此确立永久免费层或统一取消权。

隐私通知说明停用会移除账户访问及可见性，但备份副本可能为法律或合规原因保留。保留按目的确定，没有固定清理期限。应区分结束订阅、停用账户、移除访客与请求删除，在失去访问前取得退出产物，并核对选定托管及处理方条款。本研究未取消服务、接受协议或请求擦除。

secondary_questions: Can a Standard member delete trash permanently?
How is a guest different from a portal member?
